tools.name: get_nutrient

tools.name: check_dose
tools.description: Compare an amount of a vitamin or mineral with the adult RDA and upper limit. For requests like "is 5000 IU of vitamin D too much?", "is 500 mg of magnesium glycinate safe?", "is 10 mg of melatonin a lot?" or "is 300 mg of caffeine too much?". Handles IU, mcg, mg and g, including IU for vitamins A,

tools.name: check_stack
tools.description: Add up everything someone takes and check the daily totals against adult upper limits. For requests like "I take Centrum, vitamin D 5000 IU and zinc 50 mg, is that too much?" or "is it OK to take OLLY Sleep with extra melatonin?".
